name: Kutapasaushruta

name: Kuthumi

name: Kuthumin

name: Kutigu

name: Kutimukha

name: Laditamaheshvara

name: Laduna
meaning_en: Name of a son and commander of Bhaṇḍa.

name: Lagadha

name: Laghuvishnu

name: Lahya

name: Lauhitya

meaning_en: Name of the middle one of the 101 sons of Viśvāmitra; invited for the Rājasūya of Yudhiṣṭhira; a sage; a Kauśika Brahmiṣṭha.

name: Madhuvarna

name: Madiraksha

name: Mahaghosheshvara

name: Mahamaudgalyayana
meaning_en: Name of a disciple of Buddha.

name: Mahambuka
meaning_en: Name of Śiva, (perhaps w.r. for mahAmbu-da; cf. -meGa).

name: Mahamrityumjaya

name: Mahamuda
meaning_en: Name of a Yakṣa, son of Devajanī.

name: Mahan
meaning_en: Name of a son of Dhīmān.

name: Mahanada

name: Mahanaman

name: Mahanetra

name: Mahapadma

name: Mahapamshu

name: Mahapanthaka

name: Mahaparanika
meaning_en: Name of a disciple of Buddha.

name: Mahapasha
meaning_en: Name of an officer of Yama.

name: Mahaphana

name: Mahapurna
meaning_en: Name of a king of the Garuḍas.

name: Maharatha

name: Maharddhiprapta
meaning_en: Name of a prince of the Garuḍas.

name: Mahasagaraprabhagambhiradhara
meaning_en: Name of a king of the Garuḍas.

name: Mahasatva

name: Mahasha

name: Mahashala

name: Mahashamkha

name: Mahashila

name: Mahashirsha

name: Mahasvat

name: Mahaugha

name: Mahavegalabdhasthama

name: Mahavishva

name: Mahavita

name: Mahayashas

name: Maheshchandra

name: Maheshvarabhatta

name: Maheshvaradikshita
meaning_en: Name of an author (˚tIya n. his wk.).

name: Maheshvarasimha

name: Maheshvaratirtha

name: Mahi

name: Mahidasa

name: Mahinetra

name: Mahirana

name: Mahisha

name: Mahmadakhana

name: Mahogra

name: Mahoraga

name: Mahoshnisha

name: Mahya
meaning_en: Name of a son of Vivas- vat.

name: Mainda

name: Mairavana

name: Maithila
meaning_en: Name of the son of the Mithila king, Śatadhanva.

name: Maitra
meaning_en: Name of a particular class of evil beings or demons who feed on purulent carcases (Manu XII.

name: Maitravaruna
meaning_en: Name of a resident of Brahmakṣetra; a Vāsiṣṭha and a sage; Purohita of Ikṣvāku.

name: Maitrayanavara
meaning_en: Name of a son of Divodāsa; his descendents became Bhārgava Brāhmaṇas.
